Interaction.title: Interaction
Interaction.description: User journal entry or multi-turn reflection session with Gemini

id.description: Unique identifier of the interaction session

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner

title.description: Title of the reflection journal entry

category.description: Category tag for the journal entry

mode.description: AI assistance mode used in this session

mood.description: Optional mood emoji tag describing emotional state of the entry

location.description: Optional pinned Google Maps geographical location attached to the journal entry

summary.description: Concise AI-generated summary of the reflection

keyInsights.description: Key takeaways extracted from the interaction

AdminProfile.title: AdminProfile
AdminProfile.description: Administrative role definition and elevated privilege record

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the administrator

email.description: Verified email address of the administrator

role.description: Role designation within the RBAC system

NotificationConfig.title: NotificationConfig
NotificationConfig.description: System-wide and user external notification webhook settings

slackEnabled.description: Whether Slack webhook notifications are enabled

discordEnabled.description: Whether Discord webhook notifications are enabled

emailEnabled.description: Whether email dispatch notifications are enabled

emailEndpoint.description: Email dispatch endpoint or alert address

triggerCategories.description: Journal categories that trigger automated external alerts

notifyOnCrisis.description: Whether distress safe mode activations trigger high-priority alerts

notifyOnKeyInsights.description: Whether extracted key insights trigger external notifications

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp of last configuration update

AdminAuditLog.title: AdminAuditLog
AdminAuditLog.description: Immutable security and administrative audit event record

id.description: Unique identifier of the audit log event

eventType.description: Categorized administrative or security event type

actorUid.description: UID of the user or system component initiating the action

actorEmail.description: Email of the actor if authenticated

timestamp.description: ISO timestamp when the audit event occurred

/users/{userId}/interactions/{interactio.description: User-isolated reflections, journal entries, and multi-turn conversations with Gemini

/admins/{adminId}.description: System administrator identity and role assignment records

/system/notifications.description: System-wide notification rules and external webhook routing configurations

/admin_audit_logs/{logId}.description: Immutable administrative and security audit trail events
